runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 08:37 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new candidate beat the existing LIVE set after location, language, skill and ranking gates. IZY VAPE e-commerce/back-office was directly re-opened and remains an excellent existing LIVE fit: mostly home office from anywhere in Slovakia, occasional planned Bratislava meetings, WooCommerce/e-shop operations and AI/process work; English is described in detail as an advantage for routine written communication despite the structured B1 label. New WEM Advisory back office was rejected for mandatory financial-sector experience, advanced Excel and B2 English. Eric SK/Fusakle seasonal e-shop office support is eligible in Bratislava-Dubravka but ranked below stronger existing e-commerce roles because it is temporary and pays from 7 EUR/h. AUTO-Prestige admin/CRM is locally eligible but not strong enough to displace current higher-ranked admin roles. Facebook public indexing produced 0 verified direct hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job-ID deduplication
developmentChanges.reason: Extract stable source job identifiers before fuzzy company+title identity so alternate/localized URLs cannot create duplicate LIVE cards.

developmentChanges.title: Dynamic recent-delta fallback
developmentChanges.reason: If a recent-delta manifest is stale or unavailable, derive a bounded fallback rather than silently hiding newly verified records.

developmentChanges.title: Manifest staleness diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Separate source-verification age, content age and manifest age so an apparently fresh timestamp cannot hide stale evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Safer normalized identity dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize common legal-form and title boilerplate before final identity comparison while keeping stable IDs intact.

developmentChanges.title: Structured vs detail language reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: When a job board structured field says B1/B2 but the detailed text says the language is only an advantage or routine written communication, store both pieces of evidence and rank from the stricter verified reality instead of blindly trusting one field. This reduces false negatives such as e-commerce roles where the narrative requirement is materially softer than the metadata label.

developmentChanges.title: Temporary-role value-density score
developmentChanges.reason: Score seasonal/short-term roles by hourly pay, schedule compatibility, transferable target skills and application effort so low-paid temporary listings do not crowd out stronger permanent e-commerce/admin opportunities while still surfacing genuinely useful stackable work.
